title: Build a Simple Reflex Agent
description: Implement a rule-based vacuum cleaner agent function that perceives its environment and chooses actions.
problemStatement: Implement an intelligent agent function `reflex_vacuum_agent(location, status)` that returns the optimal action string for a 2-room environment ('A' and 'B'). If the current room status is `'DIRTY'`, return `'CLEAN'`. If the room is `'CLEAN'` and location is `'A'`, return `'RIGHT'`. If clean and in `'B'`, return `'LEFT'`.
hints: Check status == 'DIRTY' first before checking room locations.
Return string literal uppercase action names: 'CLEAN', 'RIGHT', or 'LEFT'.
